timing_protocol.architecture_profile: Additional continuous-frame verification at declared frame_ii_cycles, with mixed gaps and dense reset probes; original 384-cycle workload remains mandatory

hardware.cell_library: ASAP7 RVT/TT combinational and sequential cells
hardware.hold_check: minimum-delay STA must pass; common incremental hold repair after compile_ultra

interface.sampling: Inputs stable before rising edge; outputs observed after that edge; first input edge is cycle 0.

scoring.resolved: all selected-profile numerical, protocol, timing and RTL/mapped requirements pass; independent of score
scoring.area: clip((A_ref-A)/(A_ref-0.5*A_ref),0,1); A_ref is smallest validated accurate mapped area
scoring.architecture: 0.6*S_A + 0.3*S_T + 0.1*S_L; independent accurate-baseline envelope and targets in frozen policy
scoring.frequency: architecture only: passing setup/hold endpoint from reconstraint and STA clock scan on fixed mapped netlist; 0.01ns bracket
scoring.throughput: certified Fmax / verified declared frame_ii_cycles (FFTs/s); claim 64..384, default 384
scoring.latency_score: worst first-output cycles at common 10ns clock, including dense stream test; no second frequency reward
scoring.SQNR: hard constraint only; no bonus above threshold
scoring.missing_calibration: score_valid=false; hardware feasibility remains separately available
scoring.measurement_stage: pre-layout synthesis and ideal-interconnect STA; not post-route or silicon Fmax

verification.rtl: VCS four-state, ordinary unspecified initial state and synchronous-reset checks
verification.mapped: VCS four-state logic, full RTL comparison from three time-zero register initializations: all zero, all one, and seed 20261121
verification.initialization_scope: time zero only; no forcing or repair during reset, processing or output
verification.motivation: avoid false failures from reconvergent reset X-pessimism while requiring recovery from multiple physical binary initial states
verification.guarantee: empirical full-transaction RTL/netlist equivalence; optional formal proof is reported separately
